description: List German hospitality-receipt (Bewirtungsbeleg) overlays attached to the user's transactions. Each row carries the underlying transactionId, date, location, occasion, total/tip/subtotal split, deductible vs non-deductible amounts, and signing state. Pass `transactionHash` (from `get_transactions`) to scope to one transaction. Default page 20, max 100.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination.

transactionHash.description: Restrict to overlays linked to a single transaction (on-chain hash from get_transactions).

name: list_bewirtungsbelege
